A prior confirmed fraud case (AGENT-HHG-016) on the same card and device reinforces the suspicion. Multiple other cards share the same device, indicating broader abuse. Based on the evidence, the transaction is classified as fraud.

The same device has been linked to multiple confirmed fraud cases for this customer. Given the high risk score, device anomaly, and prior fraud history, the transaction is deemed fraudulent under the card‑not‑present fraud pattern.
